name: Pairhush Palm
description: Strike with a palm that carries one silence and follows with a second so the blow lands without any sound.

name: Pairhush Guard
description: Hold two silences before the chest in the school's first guard.

name: Pairhush Sense
description: Listen into the space between the two silences and hear what moves there.

name: Pairhush Seal
description: Close both silences on the qi of a foe and seal it from two sides.

name: Pairhush Drain
description: Draw the strength of an opponent out in two quiet streams.

name: Pairhush Purge
description: Let one silence take the taint from an ally and the other swallow it.

name: Pairhush Annul
description: Cross the silences over a great technique and annul it before it takes its full shape.

name: Pairhush Wave
description: Send a wave of paired silence over the ground to drain the strength of all who stand in it.

name: Pairhush Erasure
description: Meet the two silences on the target and erase it from within past any ward.

name: Voidpair Silence
description: The school's finishing move in which both silences close together over the field and no technique can rise or land inside them for as long as the user's reserve holds.

name: Crownvoid Jab
description: Jab upward at the head with a finger that has a crown of nothing about it.

name: Crownvoid Ward
description: Raise a crown of nothing over the head to take what falls from above.

name: Crownvoid Sense
description: Read the whole field through the top of the crown and note every dead spot.

name: Crownvoid Step
description: Step along the first track and arrive along the second in a single beat.

name: Crownvoid Seal
description: Seal a foe's qi under the crown so it cannot gather or leave.

name: Crownvoid Purge
description: Pull a curse from an ally up through the crown and out of the world.

name: Crownvoid Drain
description: Drain the strength of a group of foes up into the crown.

name: Crownvoid Rend
description: Rend the guard of a foe with an edge of the crown.

name: Crownvoid Annul
description: Hold the crown against a great technique and annul it in one close.

name: Crownvoid Burst
description: Let the crown burst outward in a ring of unmaking round the user.

name: Crownvoid Phase
description: Pass the whole body through a solid barrier by emptying the crown and the track.

name: Dual Void Crown
description: The school's highest move in which both tracks meet at the crown and the joined void closes over the field and empties everything it holds.

name: Hushsworn Fist
description: Hit with a fist sworn to stillness that makes no sound against any gale.

name: Hushsworn Guard
description: Hold still against the wind with a guard that has nothing in it to be pushed.

name: Hushsworn Sense
description: Read the hush for any sound or sign that crosses it.

name: Hushsworn Gust
description: Loose a gust of emptiness that cuts through the wind without a sound.

name: Hushsworn Seal
description: Seal the qi of a foe in still air and hold it in place.

name: Hushsworn Purge
description: Hush a curse out of an ally in the calm of the oath.

name: Hushsworn Drain
description: Draw the force from a charging foe as it nears the sworn hush.

name: Hushsworn Annul
description: Stake the oath on a great technique and annul it in the air.

name: Hushsworn Tempest
description: Raise a tempest of silence that strips the force from all in its path.

name: Hushsworn Absorb
description: Draw the strength of a gale or a blast into the sworn hush and make it still.

name: Stormstilling Void
description: The school's greatest answer in which the sworn hush stills a whole storm of wind and technique at once.

name: Deepvoid Pulse
description: Send up a pulse from the deep void that weakens those standing close.

name: Deepvoid Ward
description: Hold a ward from the deep void before the body that gives blows nothing to strike.

name: Deepvoid Sense
description: Listen for the deep void and feel what moves in the gap beneath the ground.

name: Deepvoid Step
description: Drop through a seam of the deep void and rise a few paces away.

name: Deepvoid Seal
description: Sink the qi of a foe into the deep void and keep it sealed there.

name: Deepvoid Purge
description: Sink a curse from an ally down into the deep void and leave the ally clean.

name: Deepvoid Drain
description: Draw the strength of foes slowly down into the dark below.

name: Deepvoid Rend
description: Rend the footing of a foe and drop the foe into a sudden hollow.

name: Deepvoid Annul
description: Sink a great technique into the deep void before it can land.

name: Deepvoid Sink
description: Cause the ground to sink into a wide hollow with the foes in it.

name: Deepvoid Erasure
description: Draw the target down into the deep void and erase it past any ward.

name: Voidheart Oath
description: The school's deepest oath spoken to the heart of the void that opens a silent sinking under the field and drains all strength into it.
